entities.name: Query UbiE protein
observations: 243 aa protein with predicted molecular mass 27.25 kDa and theoretical pI 5.99.
Matches reviewed UbiE homologs at 54.4–66.5% identity with 98.4–99.2% query coverage.
Contains Pfam Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25) at residues 17–242 with i-Evalue 4.9e-80.
Additional methyltransferase Pfam hits support an SAM-dependent methyltransferase fold.
Function assignment is homology-based rather than direct biochemical validation.

entities.name: UbiE C-methyltransferase
observations: Reviewed bacterial UbiE proteins catalyze C-methylation in ubiquinone and/or menaquinone biosynthesis.
Annotated reactions use S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor and produce S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.
Representative reviewed homolog Q9X3X2 has EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201 annotations.

entities.name: Menaquinone biosynthesis
observations: UbiE homologs are annotated in the menaquinone biosynthetic process and quinol/quinone metabolism.
The inferred role is the terminal C-methylation of demethylmenaquinol to menaquinol.

entities.name: Ubiquinone biosynthesis
observations: UbiE homologs are annotated in ubiquinone/cofactor biosynthesis and can methylate 2-polyprenyl-6-methoxy-1,4-benzoquinol.
Exact substrate usage may vary among organisms.

entities.name: S-adenosyl-L-methionine
observations: Candidate methyl donor in the UbiE-catalyzed reaction, inferred from the EC/Rhea annotations of close reviewed homologs.
